title: Design: on a phone the + and the Labor and Parts fields look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is a phone screen 390 px wide, and the design pictures "phone-05-n6-add-menu.png" (board 6.5), "phone-06-n6-added.png" (board 6.6) and "phone-07-n6-parts-list.png" (board 6.7) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer), card expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Tap the + and compare with the picture of board 6.5.
  2. Add Parts and compare with the picture of board 6.6.
  3. Tap "Sales Representative - Parts" and compare with the picture of board 6.7.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu "Sales Representative - Parts".
  • Step 2: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", both {Sales-rep-A}, labels in full; the remove x (32 px) always showing beside Parts; each field shows its arrow.
  • Step 3: the same list per row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R1: “Tapping a Sales Representative field opens the same dropdown Lead Technician and Service Advisor open on a phone, with the same options as on a desktop (S1-R8, S1-R9).”
  • S3-R2: “The + and remove x buttons are always shown, at the same 32px size (S2-R1, S2-R8), and work as on a desktop (Story 2).”
  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 11: “11. (a) Always show the dropdown arrow, as the feature spec says.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 6.5 Tap the +; 6.6 Parts added; 6.7 Parts list on a phone (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: The picture of board 6.6 shows no dropdown arrow at rest (the board 6.6 note, quoted below, says the rows read as plain text). Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 that the arrow always shows on a touch screen, as the PRD says (answer 11, quoted above); this case follows it.

Design pictures attached to this case: phone-05-n6-add-menu.png, phone-06-n6-added.png, phone-07-n6-parts-list.png.

  • Design — board 6.5 title: “6.5 Tap the +”
  • Design — board 6.5 note: “The menu: "Sales Representative - Parts".”
  • Design — board 6.6 title: “6.6 Parts added”
  • Design — board 6.6 note: “"Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", both Becky; labels in full; the Parts row has its remove x, always showing. At rest the rows read as plain text.”
  • Design — board 6.7 title: “6.7 Parts list on a phone”
  • Design — board 6.7 note: “The same list per row. With Labor and Parts showing, the arrow sits on the name line in the bottom corner (decision 70).”
